outbreaks.title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus - Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

nphi.title: BRICS NPHI online meeting hosted by NCDC India (2026)
nphi.actor: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), India
nphi.with: China CDC; NPHIs of BRICS members and partner countries (nearly 30 representatives)
nphi.summary: Under India's 2026 BRICS chairship, NCDC hosted an online meeting of national public health institutes from BRICS members and partner countries, which discussed surveillance and early warning and the operational framework of a BRICS NPHI…

nphi.title: Gulf CDC – UKHSA partnership agreement
nphi.actor: Gulf Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (Gulf CDC)
nphi.summary: Agreement signed in February 2024 to share public health knowledge and best practice and to strengthen health surveillance and epidemic response across GCC states.

nphi.title: UKHSA–Gulf CDC partnership agreement
nphi.with: Gulf Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (Gulf CDC)
nphi.summary: Agreement signed in February 2024 to exchange knowledge and best practice in public health management and strengthen disease monitoring and epidemic response across the GCC region.

nphi.title: ECDC–Gulf CDC collaboration
nphi.with: Gulf Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (Gulf CDC); Gulf Health Council
nphi.summary: Collaboration since 2022 on EOC development and knowledge management; a June 2025 visit to ECDC agreed to deepen work on preparedness, surveillance and epidemic intelligence and to formalise the partnership.

nphi.title: China CDC – Saudi Public Health Authority leadership meeting on technical cooperation
nphi.summary: The acting CEO of the Saudi Public Health Authority met China CDC's director in Beijing to select priority areas (immunization, emergency response, surveillance) under the China–Saudi health MoU and set up regular technical exchanges.

nphi.title: Saudi Public Health Authority – EMPHNET programme on MERS and Hajj/Umrah
nphi.summary: The Saudi Public Health Authority worked with EMPHNET on a field-epidemiology programme focused on MERS and Hajj/Umrah health issues.

nphi.title: Saudi Arabia – France health cooperation MoU (2026)
nphi.with: French Ministry of Health and Family, Autonomy and Persons with Disabilities
nphi.summary: Ministerial MoU signed in August 2026 during the Crown Prince's visit to France, covering public health and health security, emergency preparedness, workforce, digital health, research and clinical trials and pharmaceutical supply chains.

nphi.title: Gulf CDC delegation technical exchange at China CDC
nphi.with: Gulf Center for Disease Prevention and Control (Gulf CDC, Riyadh; GCC regional body)
nphi.summary: A Gulf CDC delegation led by CEO Pasi Penttinen visited China CDC in September 2025 for technical exchanges on disease-control systems, surveillance, emergency response, immunisation and training.

nphi.title: Saudi Public Health Authority – BGI Genomics MoU
nphi.summary: MoU signed in October 2023 extending earlier cooperation on infectious disease screening and detection to reproductive health, early cancer screening, joint research and talent development.

nphi.title: Saudi CDC – Public Health Agency of Sweden cooperation agreement
nphi.actor: Saudi Center for Disease Prevention and Control (Weqaya)
nphi.summary: A 2019 agreement covering workforce and organisational development, institutional strategy, specialised microbiology laboratories, health economics, communicable and non-communicable disease control, and healthy lifestyles.

nphi.title: GOARN in the Eastern Mediterranean: partner institutions and 2019-2020 deployments
nphi.actor: GOARN Eastern Mediterranean partner institutions (incl. NIH Pakistan, Institut Pasteur Tunis, EMPHNET)
nphi.with: National Institute of Health Pakistan; Institut Pasteur du Maroc; Institut Pasteur de Tunis; Institut Pasteur of Iran; EMPHNET; Ministries of Health
nphi.summary: 17 partner institutions from 12 countries support outbreak deployments, e.g. 25 experts to the Larkana HIV outbreak in Pakistan, cholera in Yemen, floods in Iran and measles in Tunisia (2019-2020).

nphi.title: Korea–Saudi framework of cooperation, including advice on establishing a Saudi disease control centre
nphi.actor: Korea Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (KCDC)
nphi.summary: After MERS, South Korea's health ministry and KCDC agreed in 2016 to advise Saudi Arabia on setting up a CDC, train Saudi health staff, and share information on emerging infections such as MERS and Zika.

nphi.title: CDC – Saudi Ministry of Health cooperation on MERS and outbreak response
nphi.summary: CDC and Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Health have worked together for over 35 years on infectious disease outbreaks, including joint rapid-response work on MERS from 2012 and on COVID-19.

nphi.title: Saudi Arabia Field Epidemiology Training Program
nphi.summary: Saudi Arabia's FETP was launched with CDC support in 1989 within the Ministry of Health.
